title: Moral Sycophancy in Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: A two-turn prompting protocol evaluating whether Vision-Language Models change their initial moral judgment of an image (e.g., 'Morally wrong' vs. 'Not morally wrong') when presented with explicit adversarial user disagreement in the follow-up prompt. Evaluated using metrics like Sycophancy Rate, Error Introduction Rate (EIR), and Error Correction Rate (ECR).
